content: Further Sufi addressees in the Munshaʾāt named by MK: Khwāja Ẓahīr al-Dīn Muḥammad (letter 46, which opens praying against the wiles of the envious and hostile and invoking the Sufis' spiritual support), Sayyid Bahāʾ al-Dīn (possibly Bahāʾ al-Dīn ʿUmar Jaghāraʾī, d. 857/1453), Mīr Makhdūm and his disciples, Ẓāfir al-Dīn, and two unnamed Sufis whose letter reports the proceedings of a majlis.
